title: Nodes can be purchased for extremely low price
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** Low  ## Description  The code snippet below is from the `deploy-multichain.js` file. As we can see, we use `usdcBasePrice` (parsed mwei value) during deployment instead of the `finalUSDCBasePrice` (parsed ether value) variable. USDC has 18 decimals on BSC mainnet while on other chains it is 6.
